title: CSC Site Discovery
subtitle: Quick Walk (<15s), 8x8 CLAHE OCR, Step-PDR, Hold-to-Talk Mic & .cscwalk.zip
description: Offline-First HVAC Controls & Equipment Field Survey Companion v2.0: <15s Quick Walk Single-Card Mode, Clone +1 Tag Incrementer, Global Hold-to-Talk 150Hz Mic Pill, 8x8 Local Tile CLAHE + Raw Color Toggle, Binary EXIF GPS/Compass, ASHRAE Ch. 38 + EPA A2L Serial/Model Decoder, BAS Thermistor/I-O Overlay, Pinch-Zoom Map + In-App Camera Step-Peak PDR Walk, Fail-Open Valve/Damper/VA Sizers, and .cscwalk.zip Packager.
tagline: Offline-First HVAC/BAS Field Survey Companion • Division 23 Checklists, CLAHE Nameplate OCR & Building Mapper

quickstart.step: Initialize Your Site Walk (`⚙️ Walk / API Vault`)
quickstart.detail: Tap `⚙️ Walk / API Vault` (or `Walk / Export`) to enter the Facility Name, CSC Job/Estimate Number (`CSC-26-xxxx`), and optionally save a personal Gemini API key in your private on-device Vault.

quickstart.step: Add Equipment Stations & Select System Type
quickstart.detail: Create stations for AHUs, RTUs, Chillers, Boilers, Hydronic Pumps, VAVs, or Main BAS TCPs. The app dynamically loads the matchingCSC Division 23 (`RFI-23-001` through `RFI-23-011`) engineering checklist.

quickstart.step: Capture 3-Slot Burst Photos w/ Stamped-Metal CLAHE
quickstart.detail: Snap (1) Wide Equipment Context, (2) Rusted/Stamped Nameplate (auto-enhanced via local CLAHE contrast boosting + serial vintage decoding), and (3) Inside Control Cabinet / Termination Strip.

quickstart.step: Pin Evacuation Floorplan & Export Survey Package
quickstart.detail: Snap the wall-mounted Building Evacuation Map, tap to drop equipment pins with GNSS/Compass bearings, record 150Hz high-pass filtered voice walkthroughs, and export the complete JSON/CSV package via Android Share Sheet.

navigation_map.purpose: Add, filter, and switch between rooftop, mechanical room, and terminal unit stations during a walk.
Dynamic RFI-23-001..011 checklists, 3-slot CLAHE camera capture, serial age decoder, and 150Hz filtered voice notes.
Pin equipment stations directly onto photographed floorplans/evacuation maps with compass orientation and Laplacian video sharpness scoring.
On-site deterministic Cv valve sizer (4–5 psi ΔP / β ≥ 0.50), NEC Art. 725 80% Class 2 panel VA sizer, and rough-in labor estimator.
Manage walk metadata, optional Gemini OCR key, Golden Demo Walk loader, and 1-tap JSON/CSV exports.

deep_dive_features.title: CSC Overlay & Safety Checklist Enforcement (`RFI-23-001`..`011`)
deep_dive_features.body: Prompts field engineers to verify factory OEM BACnet cards (`Overlay, Never Gut`), hardwired VFD HOA/speed split (`RFI-23-006`), DPDT manual-reset serpentine freeze stats (`RFI-23-007`), Div 23 21 13 inline valve/well boundaries (`RFI-23-005`), and dedicated Div 26 120VAC 15A TCP circuits (`RFI-23-009`).

deep_dive_features.title: CLAHE Stamped-Aluminum Nameplate Enhancer & Offline Queue
deep_dive_features.body: Applies local canvas Contrast-Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization so sun-bleached or rusted outdoor RTU/chiller data plates become legible instantly—working 100% offline in mechanical basements.

deep_dive_features.title: 150Hz Mechanical-Room High-Pass Audio Filter
deep_dive_features.body: Uses WebAudio high-pass filtering to strip low-frequency fan/pump rumble (`<150Hz`) from walk-and-talk voice memos for crystal-clear Whisper transcription back at the office.

pro_tips: Always enforce NFPA 70E Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) and PPE before opening live control cabinets for internal termination photos.
No cell signal in a sub-basement chiller plant? Leave the API key blank—every photo, checklist, and voice clip saves to IndexedDB/RollupBridge offline.
